platforms.name: macOS
platforms.description: AppKit's controls of macOS 26 and later, measured from AppKit's own rendering.

platforms.name: Windows
platforms.description: WinUI 3's Fluent 2 controls of Windows 11, from the theme resources of microsoft-ui-xaml.

platforms.name: Linux
platforms.description: GNOME's libadwaita controls, from the libadwaita 1.7 stylesheet.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.description: An alert with a title, a message and buttons, the last the default: macOS's NSAlert, Windows 11's ContentDialog with the default button first, or GNOME's AdwAlertDialog. The index returned is the same on every platform.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.description: A text input suggesting the options that contain what was typed, in the platform's text field box: macOS's bezeled field, Windows 11's TextBox or GNOME's entry; the list of suggestions is MyGo's in the platform's theme.

components.name: Badge
components.description: A small label for a count: Windows 11's InfoBadge in the accent color, GNOME's indicator badge; macOS has no badge control of its own and keeps MyGo's.

components.name: Button
components.description: A push button: macOS's push button, Windows 11's button with its elevation border, or GNOME's text button.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: A check box with a label, sized and filled as the platform draws its own.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: A field whose text filters a list of options, in the platform's text field box; the list is MyGo's.

components.name: Divider
components.description: A line between parts of a view in the platform's separator color: separatorColor, DividerStrokeColorDefault or $border_color.

components.name: EditableText
components.description: A text edited in place, as a file's name in Finder: package ui's, in the platform's theme. The input it shows while editing is built inside it, out of reach of a style applied to what it returns.

components.name: Field
components.description: A labeled control: in a Form the labels line up before the controls as in a macOS form; elsewhere the label is above, 8 DIPs on Windows 11 as a TextBox's header.

components.name: GridView
components.description: A scrolling grid of items built as they show: package ui's, in the platform's theme. MyGo builds each item's frame around its content, so the cells of NSCollectionView, GridView and GtkGridView are not drawn.

components.name: Link
components.description: Text that opens a URL in the platform's link color: AppKit's linkColor, Windows 11's AccentTextFillColorPrimary with its pointer-over and pressed shades, libadwaita's accent_color; underlined on Windows and GNOME.

components.name: List
components.description: A scrolling list of rows built as they show: macOS's inset NSTableView with its rounded selection, Windows 11's ListView with the accent pill on the chosen item, or GNOME's GtkListView with the accent-tinted row. The choice, the keys and accessibility are MyGo's.

components.name: MenuButton
components.description: A button drawn as the platform's pull-down button, opening the system's own native menu.

components.name: Modal
components.description: A dialog over the window: a sheet with a window's shadow on macOS, which leaves the window undimmed, a ContentDialog on Windows 11, or a floating AdwDialog over a dimmed window on GNOME.

components.name: NumberInput
components.description: A field editing a number with a stepper beside it: package ui's, in the platform's theme. Its field and stepper are built inside it, out of reach of a style applied to what it returns.

components.name: Outline
components.description: A list of items in a tree, built as they show: package ui's, in the platform's theme. MyGo builds the arrows and the chosen row around the content, out of reach of NSOutlineView's, TreeView's or GtkTreeExpander's look.

components.name: OutlineTable
components.description: An outline whose rows are a table's, the arrows in its first column: package ui's, in the platform's theme, as Table and Outline are.

components.name: Popover
components.description: A panel beside an element: a menu-like panel on macOS, Windows 11's FlyoutPresenter, or a libadwaita popover.

components.name: PopoverMenuButton
components.description: A button drawn as the platform's pull-down button, opening a menu MyGo draws in the window in the platform's theme.

components.name: PrimaryButton
components.description: The main action in the accent color: macOS's default button, Windows 11's accent button or GNOME's suggested action.

components.name: Progress
components.description: A progress bar, or a moving one for a negative value: macOS's bar, Windows 11's thin ProgressBar, or GNOME's progress bar.

components.name: Radio
components.description: A radio button with a label: macOS's 16-point radio button, Windows 11's RadioButton with its growing dot, or GNOME's grouped check button.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: The group radio buttons choose within, which the arrows move through: package ui's container around the platform's radio buttons.

components.name: SearchField
components.description: A search field with a magnifying glass and a clear button: macOS's capsule search field, Windows 11's AutoSuggestBox, or GNOME's search entry.

components.name: Segmented
components.description: A segmented control choosing one of a few views: macOS's NSSegmentedControl, Windows 11's SelectorBar, or GNOME's AdwToggleGroup.

components.name: Select
components.description: A drop-down choosing one of a list: macOS's pop-up button and menu, Windows 11's ComboBox with its accent pill, or GNOME's drop-down and popover.

components.name: Slider
components.description: A slider setting a value in a range: macOS's capsule knob, Windows 11's thumb with its accent dot, or GNOME's scale.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: An indicator of work of unknown length: macOS's spokes, Windows 11's ProgressRing, or GNOME's AdwSpinner.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Arrows stepping a number: the box is the platform's (NSStepper on macOS, a button's face elsewhere); the arrows, holding to repeat and the keys are MyGo's.

components.name: Switch
components.description: A switch with the platform's track, knob and motion: a capsule knob on macOS, a growing knob on Windows, a round slider on GNOME.

components.name: Table
components.description: A table of rows and columns: package ui's, in the platform's theme. MyGo has no table base to draw the platform's rows on.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Tabs choosing a page: macOS's tab view, Windows 11's SelectorBar, or GNOME's notebook tabs.

components.name: TextArea
components.description: A multi-line text input in the platform's text view: a bezel-bordered view on macOS, a TextBox on Windows 11, a framed view on GNOME.

components.name: TextInput
components.description: A single-line text input in the platform's field: macOS's bezeled field with its focus ring, Windows 11's TextBox with the accent line, or GNOME's filled entry.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: A button that stays pressed: macOS's push-on-push-off button, Windows 11's ToggleButton in the accent color, or GNOME's checked toggle button.

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.description: Toggles joined as the platform joins them: an NSSegmentedControl selecting any segments on macOS, a box.linked on GNOME, ToggleButtons side by side on Windows 11, which has no joined toggles.

components.name: TokenField
components.description: A field of tokens, as of tags, in the platform's text field box: macOS's bezeled field, Windows 11's TextBox or GNOME's entry. The chips and the suggestions are MyGo's in the platform's theme, not NSTokenField's or TokenizingTextBox's tokens; GNOME has no token field.

components.name: Tree
components.description: A tree of items that open and close: package ui's, in the platform's theme. MyGo has no tree base to draw the platform's rows on.

components.name: TreeItem
components.description: An item of a Tree: package ui's, in the platform's theme.
